item.title: IDE ATA 存储
item.description: 集成驱动电子设备将磁盘专用控制逻辑移入驱动器，并 standardized the host-facing registers and commands. The resulting ATA family dominated PC storage before Serial ATA, but several related names describe different parts of that history.
